note: Declares every template, where it is written, its substitution variables, and how upgrade mode treats it. The generator validates output against this: any file still containing an unreplaced {{VAR}}, a TODO, or a placeholder is rejected before it reaches the user.

templates.note: Harness code. No substitutions - reads all config from harness.yaml.
Regenerated so protocol fixes reach every project. Project-specific content lives in project-context.md, which is merged instead.

templates.mergeRule: Regenerate sections marked GENERATED (Architecture, Hotspots, Verification, Knowledge). Preserve every hand-written section, especially Known debt and Prose conventions. Report what was replaced.

templates.note: BASE_SHA and TASK_ID stay as literal tokens - the orchestrator substitutes them per task at delegation time.

templates.mergeRule: CLAUDE.md often already exists with project instructions. Append the harness pointer section; never overwrite existing content.

templates.note: Takes BASE_REF as $1. Fails on a suppression added in the diff with no 'why:' justification.

Enforces Syncfusion rule: never suppress, hide, catch or CSS-hide a licensing banner.

templates.emitWhen: overlay includes syncfusion AND product includes blazor
templates.note: Catches three silent-failure modes: missing AddSyncfusionBlazor (empty render), missing theme stylesheet (unstyled), missing render mode in .NET 8+ (events never fire).

generatedNotFromTemplate.how: Composed from the matched profile plus overlays, filtered to the chosen tier, with only gates whose tools resolved. Never emit a gate for an absent tool - emit the installHint in PROPOSE instead.
generatedNotFromTemplate.mergeRule: Append new profile gates. Preserve every existing threshold, custom gate, and hand edit. Report profile gates that were removed upstream rather than deleting them.

generatedNotFromTemplate.how: Fetched from the profile's and overlay's cited URLs. Every rule carries a Source: line with a retrieval date. If fetching is unavailable, write a stub naming the URL and stating that content was NOT retrieved - never fill the gap from model memory.

generatedNotFromTemplate.mergeRule: Never change a severity the repo already set. Report every rule left alone and why.

generatedNotFromTemplate.how: Append .agent/evidence/ only. Everything else in .agent/ is committed - a harness on one machine is not a harness.

Per-platform Syncfusion MCP keyed on Syncfusion_API_Key_Path (exact casing). The harness writes the config referencing ~/.syncfusion/api-key.txt and NEVER writes the key. If the file is absent, record MCP as configured-but-unauthenticated and tell the user.
generatedNotFromTemplate.emitWhen: overlay includes syncfusion and the user opts in

generatedNotFromTemplate.how: python3 .agent/tools/harness.py cp-lock — SHA-256 of every control-plane file
generatedNotFromTemplate.note: Checked by the harness-verify gate on every task. Without it the control plane is advisory: thresholds are protected by the ratchet, but a policy is just a markdown file.

generatedNotFromTemplate.how: Phase, frozen roadmap, active task, open decisions, blockers. What a fresh session reads first.
The parking lot for lane-3 decisions. Created with its header even when empty.

generatedNotFromTemplate.note: If a design document exists (design.md, DESIGN.md, docs/design-system.md, Storybook intro), REFERENCE it and never regenerate. generatedNotFromTemplate.output: custom skills / gates / workflows / policies from the interview
generatedNotFromTemplate.how: Classified per references/interview.md: command returning output -> skill; with a threshold -> gate; multi-step -> workflow; binding rule -> policy; live API -> MCP server. Check for a vendor MCP server before writing a script.
generatedNotFromTemplate.note: Generate complete: script reads credentials from the environment, gate has parser+threshold+evidence, usedBy wired. An unreferenced custom primitive is an orphan and verify reports it.

controlPlane.note: Copied wholesale from control-plane/ into .agent/, then specialised. Counts are the completeness floor, not a padding target: emit a workflow only when the project can run it, an agent only when a workflow invokes it, a skill only when its command resolves.
controlPlane.mergeRule: Never overwrite a file the project has edited. Compare by frontmatter id and version: same version and different SHA means the team customised it - keep theirs and report the upstream diff. Add new files. Report removed ones rather than deleting.
